title: FLAT TPU Kernels Beat H100 by 3x in GLA Training

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Mayank Mishra has developed a new framework for executing linear attention on Google's TPU hardware to speed up model training. The release, called FLAT, provides Pallas training kernels that enable a single TPU v6e to perform forward and backward passes up to 3x faster than Flash Linear Attention on an Nvidia H100 for GLA, and 1.5x faster for Mamba-2.

The new kernels are designed to optimize training for GLA, Mamba-2 and other linear attention architectures. Researchers Albert Gu and Percy Liang highlighted the release, which leverages Pallas to improve processing efficiency on the v6e hardware to reduce computational overhead.
